description: A compact mainly alpha binder with a four-helix up-down bundle, a densely packed core and a flat hydrophobic protein-protein interface surrounded by polar contacts.
A compact four-helix bundle with two antiparallel helical hairpins, a stable hydrophobic core and a broad shallow-concave mixed hydrophobic and polar interface.
A compact all-alpha binder with three long helices packed against one short helix, a dense core and a flat interface with a central hydrophobic patch and polar edges.
